load_envelope.normal_output: Existing worksheet simultaneous terms and 5 V/10 kohm loads; no savings booked.
load_envelope.allowance_policy: Use full repaired ledger reference/logic sensitivities, 1 mA inlet leakage per rail, +10 mA extra NOISE2 sensitivity, and 20 mA per rail for supervision/discharge/protection auxiliary demand. These are requirements/allocations, not manufacturer maxima.
load_envelope.fault_basis: One output externally forced to opposite 12 V across 998 ohm: 24.0481 mA, rounded to 25 mA per analog rail. Does not establish all-output-short or opamp rail current maxima.

source_requirement.ripple_criterion: Strictly below target; included within voltage bands; verify with bandwidth/setup recorded in qualification.
source_requirement.capacity_statement: Generated continuous/transient values are minimum REQUIRED delivery at declared source bands. No available capacity is asserted.
source_requirement.fault_policy: Source current limit and coordinated all-rail shutdown must prevent indefinite partial supply. Reverse-current blocking on all source outputs, active discharge under supervision and rail monitors at load are required; actual circuit and measured response remain #52/#57.
source_requirement.voltage_band_note: Shared AGND drop can raise one rail magnitude while reducing another. Check source maximum plus worst return shift against every upper load limit, not only subtraction at minimum.
source_requirement.current_limit_contract: Selected source or inlet must deliver minimum transient requirements yet bound each rail including tolerance to maximum_delivered_current_mA, then coordinate all-rail shutdown. Maximums are interface limits, not device ratings. Unbounded overshoot/fault energy cannot be admitted by the contact/cable checker; actual limiter dynamics require #52 circuit evidence and #57 tests.

harness.return_current_rule: Assume the entire sum of rail transient magnitudes may use any one ground conductor; never divide current equally between four contacts as a guarantee.

inlet.support: Enclosure bracket and strain relief carry insertion/cable loads; no reliance on PCB solder joints. Reservation is a requirement, not a component model.

returns.topology: Single EXT source common return bonded to instrument AGND star at inlet. Separate return conductors for rail branches join the star. All 180 patch sleeves are AGND, so patching creates parallel return paths.
returns.reference: OCTAVE_REF and all O1..O5 remain EXT; no cross-domain reference supply. Buffered taps may cross boards only within EXT and OSC-ES-1 limits.
returns.earth: Require isolated SELV external supply output with documented chassis/earth bonding; connected equipment may create an earth loop. Do not float patch sleeves or use them as sole power return.
returns.sensitive_nodes: Hold, timing, summing, integrator and slew storage nodes stay local; no additional signal normals.
